title: feat(plugin-detail): the record activity timeline folds consecutive updates by one actor into one row with a count
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9WTWRsnC3MHwk95XYn23xHC)_
Fixes #25959
Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

## What

The record activity timeline folds a run of consecutive update entries by one actor into one row with a count. This is the renderer half of #25787 (its server half, PR #25958, made each generic update summary name its changed fields).

- **Mapper** (`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/recordActivityFeed.ts`). `activityRowToFeedItem` now carries what it used to drop: the row's own `sys_activity.type` (`activityType`), its `metadata.kind` (`activityKind`), `actor_id` (`actorId`, `null` when the row names no user) and `changed_fields` (`changedFields`, only when the column is an array, so an unstamped `null` row is not read as "no fields"). Only `metadata.kind` is read from the metadata JSON; the recorded old/new values are never looked at.
- **Fold** (`foldFeedItems`, same module, pure). A run is adjacent items of the list the reader sees (after the filter): each an `updated` row with no domain kind, by the same `actorId` AND the same display name (so two unnamed writers are never merged), each at most `FOLD_WINDOW_MS` = 10 minutes after its neighbour. Any other row ends the run. A run of one is an ordinary row.
- **Render** (`RecordActivityTimeline.tsx`). The folded row shows the actor, the latest entry's time, `N updates`, and `Updated FIELDS`: the union of the changed fields, by the object's field label (from `RecordContextProvider`'s `objectSchema`, through the same translated `fieldLabel` the record sections use) and by machine name outside a record page; three names, then `N more`. A button with `aria-expanded` expands the run to its entries, each rendered exactly as an unfolded row. The panel heading still counts every entry.
- **Types** (`@object-ui/types`). Four new optional `FeedItem` members (Clause-② yes). A host item without them renders as before and never folds.
- **Strings.** `detail.foldedUpdates`, `detail.foldedUpdateCount` (count family), `detail.foldedMoreFields` (count family), `detail.expandFolded`, `detail.collapseFolded`, appended after `detail.viewSource` in all ten packs and mirrored in `DETAIL_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS`. The field list is joined with the existing `validation.formInvalidJoiner` key, not `Intl.ListFormat` (outside the package's TS lib, and measured and rejected for field lists in `form-invalid-toast-joiner.test.tsx`).
- `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` re-recorded; root changeset `.changeset/25959-activity-fold.md` (patch, `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, `@object-ui/i18n`).

No host plumbing: `RecordDetailView` already renders the discussion inside `RecordContextProvider` with `objectSchema={objectDef}`, so `RecordDetailView.tsx` is untouched.

## Choices for the seat

- **Window: 10 minutes between neighbours**, not from the first entry, so one flow writing every few minutes stays one run.
- **Adjacency after the filter.** With "Field changes" selected, two updates separated by a (hidden) comment are adjacent on screen and fold. In "All activity" the comment ends the run.
- **Never fold:** everything whose `activityType` is not `updated` (created, deleted, assigned, shared, completed, comments, host items) and any row with a `metadata.kind` (a fired milestone).

## Tests

Head `1c8752a0` (after merging `origin/main`):

- `RecordActivityTimeline.fold-25959.test.tsx` (new, 17 tests): the mapper carries the four members; `foldFeedItems` folds a run in order, splits on actor / system-vs-person / differing unnamed writers / a gap over the window, never folds the excluded kinds, counts entries without a summary; the timeline renders the thirteen-update campaign as one row with `13 updates` and the field labels, keeps the comment visible, toggles `aria-expanded` and shows all 13 entries, falls back to machine names, truncates long lists, and reads a no-field run as `Updated record`.
- Updated `recordActivityFeed.test.ts` (two exact item shapes gain `activityType` / `actorId`) and `recordActivityFeed.milestoneKind-12106.test.tsx` (the marked item also carries `activityKind`).
- Reverse check: with the fold's `updated` test mutated to never match, the new file goes 9 failed / 8 passed of 17; restored by `git checkout HEAD --`, hash-verified.
- Final run on `1c8752a0`, under `os-verify-lock.sh`: `vitest run packages/plugin-detail/ packages/i18n/` plus the app-shell activity and defaults-mirror tests (`RecordDetailView.activity*`, `.feed*`, `.replyCountOnRead`, `.recordOpenWaves`, `.authoredActivityThreading`, `.discussionFallbackPipeline`, `defaults-maps-mirror-en-pack`, `activityItemType`): **Test Files 403 passed, 1 skipped (404); Tests 4327 passed, 31 skipped**. The rest of app-shell is left to CI `Test Core`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check`: exit 0. eslint on the touched files: 0 errors.
- Gates: `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 46 commands on `1c8752a0`; all 46 exit 0, and `--ran` reconciles 46 derived / 46 run / 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero). `check-sdui-manifest` included.

## Acceptance notes

- A milestone row that the read redaction served without its `kind` (the reader is not served a field the milestone watches) and whose declaration names no `type` arrives as a plain `updated` row and can fold. That is the redaction's documented behaviour, not a new gap.
- Folding happens after `applyFeedConfig`'s page window, so a page of `limit` entries can render as fewer rows. The window still counts entries, which is what "Load more" pages over.
- The fold's expand state is keyed on the run's first entry id; "Load more" bringing an older entry into the same run collapses it again.
